blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal sentiment models are usually evaluated on complete utterances, yet streams often lose a contiguous span of text, audio, or video. We study local missingness on aligned CMU-MOSEI features. Our reliability-aware network (RM-Net) keeps the original temporal positions, represents unobserved positions with a learned token, outputs bounded per-modality intensity contributions gated by observation quality, and is trained with dual-view masking of contiguous segments. We fuse five RM-Net seeds with a LoRA-adapted BERT text expert, using a fusion weight that depends only on the visible fraction of content tokens. Architecture, checkpoint, and fusion choices were made on the validation split. On the held-out split, the fused model reaches a macro-F1 of 0.655 on clean inputs and 0.634 under 40\% mixed missingness; its two-view average exceeds the auxiliary-head baseline by 0.024 (95\% video-cluster bootstrap interval [0.003, 0.045]). Because this split was inspected during development, these numbers are not a blind test. For explanations, exact Shapley attributions over the eight modality subsets and position-level occlusion show that top-ranked positions reduce the predicted-class probability faster than random positions (AUC gap 0.113 on validation). We also describe an auditable word-level alignment pipeline for raw clips; its outputs do not feed the predictive models.
blocks.zh: 多式联运情绪模型通常用完整的语句来评价,但流往往会失去文本、音频或视频的毗连范围。 我们研究本地的缺失 与CMU-MOSEI的特征一致。 我们的可靠性意识网络(RM-Net)保持原有的时空位置,代表着不观察的位置,具有学识的标志,产出以观察质量为限制的每模式强度贡献,并接受以毗连部分的双视掩码培训。 我们把五个RM-Net种子与一个经过LORA调整的BERT文本专家结合,使用一个仅依赖于内容符号的可见分量的聚变重量. 进行了建筑、检查站和核聚变方面的选择。 在被搁置的拆分中,引信型号在清洁投入上达到0.655的宏F1,在40QQ混合缺失下达到0.634;其双视平均值超过辅助头基线0.024(95QQ视频-集群靴夹间隔[0.003,0.045]). 由于这种分裂是在开发过程中被检查的,这些数字并不是盲目测试. 为了解释,在8个模式子集和位置层封存上准确的Shapley属性显示,排名最高的位置比随机位置(AUC ship 0.113 on existance)更快地降低了预测级概率. 我们还描述了对原始剪辑可审计的字级调整管道;其产出没有为预测模型提供素材。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Sentiment is conveyed jointly through lexical content, prosody, and facial behavior, and multimodal models exploit these complementary cues ( Zadeh et al., 2017 ; Tsai et al., 2019 ) . Most such models assume that every modality is present throughout an utterance. In deployed systems this assumption fails in a structured way: a microphone drops out for a few seconds, a recognizer fails on one phrase, or a face leaves the frame. Such local, contiguous missingness differs from the random or whole-modality missingness studied in much prior work. The surviving modalities still carry evidence, and their temporal alignment with the gap must be preserved.
blocks.zh: 感想通过语法内容,发音和面部行为联合传递,多模式模型利用这些互补的提示(Zadeh等,2017;Tsai等,2019). 多数这种模式都假定,每个模式都贯穿于言辞之中。 在部署的系统中,这种假设在结构上失败:麦克风掉出几秒钟,识别器在一个短语上失败,或者脸部离开帧. 这种局部和相接的缺失不同于以前许多工作中研究的随机或全模式缺失。 幸存的模式仍然有证据,必须保持它们与差距的时间吻合。

blocks.en: Two design questions follow. First, absent spans must be distinguished from observed content: without an observation mask, z-scored zero-filling treats an absent face as a face at the training mean. Second, fusion must reflect available evidence: a text expert’s influence should shrink as words disappear.
blocks.zh: 下面是两个设计问题。 首先,缺席的跨度必须与所观察到的内容相区别:没有观察口罩,Z分数的零填充在训练中将缺席的脸当作面相. 第二,合并必须反映现有证据:文本专家的影响应该随着文字的消失而收缩。

blocks.en: We address both questions. RM-Net keeps positions fixed, marks unobserved positions explicitly, weights modalities with a reliability gate, and is trained with dual-view masking of contiguous segments. A LoRA-adapted BERT expert supplies task-adapted text evidence, and its fusion weight is a deterministic function of visible text. Explanations are computed on the deployed fused predictor rather than on attention maps, using exact Shapley attribution and position-level interventions.
blocks.zh: 我们处理两个问题。 RM-Net保持固定位置,明确标出未观察位置,采用可靠性门的加权方式,并采用相接部分的双视遮挡法进行训练。 LoRA所适应的BERT专家提供任务所适应的文本证据,其聚变重量是可见文本的决定性功能. 所部署的引信预测器而不是注意力图,使用准确的沙普利归属和位置级别干预措施来计算解释。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • an observation-aware, position-preserving sentiment network with reliability gating and dual-view training under contiguous masking; • a text-availability-gated fusion of this network with a LoRA-adapted BERT expert, with all parameters and fusion settings chosen on validation; • a controlled evaluation over 21 missingness conditions, position and length analyses, an ablation study, and a pre-encoding text-span deletion check, reported with the caveat that the held-out split was inspected earlier; • dual-target explanations for both the fused intensity and the predicted-class probability, checked with deletion and retention curves against random orderings and with class-flip analysis; • an auditable word-level alignment pipeline for raw clips, reported separately because its features do not enter the predictive results.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:在连成一体的遮罩下进行可靠地标定和双视训练的观察-意识-保留情绪网络;与经LORA调整的BERT专家进行文字可用性组合,在验证时选择所有参数和聚变设置;在21个缺失条件、位置和长度分析上进行可控评价,进行减值研究,并进行预编码文本宽度删除检查,同时警告说,已较早检查了被扣的分解;对引信强度和预测的分解概率进行双重目标解释,对照随机订购检查删除和保留曲线,并进行分级剪切分析;对原始剪接进行可审计的字级调整管道,因为其特征没有输入预测结果而单独报告。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early fusion models combine modalities through tensor products ( Zadeh et al., 2017 ) , low-rank factors ( Liu et al., 2018 ) , or shared and private representations ( Hazarika et al., 2020 ) . Cross-modal transformers model asynchronous streams directly ( Tsai et al., 2019 ) . These models generally assume complete inputs. CMU-MOSEI ( Zadeh et al., 2018 ) is the standard benchmark for this setting.
blocks.zh: 早期聚变模型通过拉诺产品结合方式(Zadeh等,2017年),低排名因素 (Liu等,2018年),或共享和私人代理(Hazarika等,2020年). 跨模式变流器直接建模同步流 (Tsai等, 2019). 这些模型一般假定完整的投入. CMU-MOSEI(Zadeh等,2018年)是这一设定的标准基准.

blocks.en: Recent work addresses incomplete inputs with dedicated mechanisms for learning under missing or corrupted modalities ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2024 ) . Two of these works study random feature-level missingness within modalities ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2024 ) . Our setting differs in its structure: we preserve the original time positions and study contiguous spans of varying length and location, and we keep the pretrained encoders frozen while adding a separately trained text expert.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作涉及不完整的投入,并设有专门机制,在缺失或腐败模式下进行学习(Zhang等,2024;Zhu等,2025;Sun等,2024)。 其中两部作品研究模式内随机特征水平缺失(朱等,2025;孙等,2024. 我们的设置在结构上有所不同:我们保留原来的时间位置并研究不同长度和位置的相接相接的跨度,我们保持预先训练的编码器被冻结,同时增加一个经过单独训练的文本专家.

blocks.en: Low-rank adaptation ( Hu et al., 2022 ) trains small update matrices on top of a frozen transformer. We apply it to BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) to obtain a text expert that is trained only on the training split.
blocks.zh: 低等级改造(Hu等,2022年)在冷冻变压器上方进行小更新矩阵. 我们将其应用到BERT(Devlin等,2019年),以获得文本专家,该文本专家仅接受分训培训.

blocks.en: Shapley values ( Shapley, 1953 ) and their SHAP instantiation ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) attribute predictions to input groups. Deletion and insertion curves measure whether highly ranked evidence matters for the output ( Petsiuk et al., 2018 ) . Attention weights are not reliable explanations by themselves ( Jain and Wallace, 2019 ) , and some gradient saliency methods fail basic sanity checks ( Adebayo et al., 2018 ) . We therefore intervene on the deployed predictor. Ensembles ( Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017 ) and calibration ( Guo et al., 2017 ) are relevant to uncertainty estimates, which we do not calibrate here.
blocks.zh: Shapley值(Shapley,1953)和他们的SHAP即时化(Lundberg and Lee,2017)将预测归属于输入组. 删除和插入曲线衡量对产出是否具有高排名的证据重要性(Petsiuk等,2018年). 注意力权重本身并不是可靠的解释(Jain and Wallace, 2019),一些梯度显著方法未能实现基本疗养检查(Adebayo等, 2018). 因此,我们干预部署的预测器。 Ensembles (Lakshminarayanan等,2017年)和校正(Guo等,2017年)与不确定性估计相关,我们在此不校正.

blocks.en: 3 Data and Input Representation
blocks.zh: 3 数据和投入说明

blocks.en: We use CMU-MOSEI ( Zadeh et al., 2018 ) utterances in an aligned format with 50 positions per modality. Text positions are BERT WordPiece positions, including [CLS] and [SEP] ; they are not words. Acoustic and visual features are the supplied 74-dimensional and 35-dimensional pre-extracted vectors; we did not produce them and did not verify the toolchain that generated them. Text is re-encoded by a frozen uncased BERT-base model ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) at a fixed revision. On observed positions these re-extracted features differ from the supplied text features by a mean absolute value on the order of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , consistent with half-precision storage.
blocks.zh: 我们使用CMU-MOSEI(Zadeh等,2018年)的语句,使用一致格式,每种模式有50个位置. 文本位置是BERT WordPiece位置,包括[CLS]和[SEP];它们不是单词. 声学和视觉特征是所供应的74维和35维预取矢量;我们没有产生它们,也没有验证产生它们的工具链. 文本由被冻结的未保存的BERT-Base模型(Devlin等,2019年)在固定修订后重新编码. 在观测到的位置上,这些再提取的特征与所提供的文本特征不同,在3×10−4 3\times 10×4}左右,与半精度存储一致。

blocks.en: These 4,850 utterances form the supplied CMU-MOSEI-derived subset, which we use with its provided split; the full CMU-MOSEI collection contains about 23,500 labelled utterances. blocks.en: We treat text, audio, and vision as three players. Shapley values give an intensity attribution and a class-probability attribution for the originally predicted class; the class target is fixed on the unperturbed input. For position-level evidence, each observed content position is occluded alone and the full output is recomputed. Positions are ranked by the intensity change | Δ ​ y | |\Delta y| and by the drop in the predicted-class probability. We report deletion and retention curves at fractions 0 , 0.1 , … , 0.8 0,0.1,\dots,0.8 against five random permutations, and the first deletion step at which the fused class changes.

blocks.en: Architecture, checkpoints, fusion exponents and weights, and class biases are chosen on the validation split. RM-Net checkpoints are selected by J = r − MAE + Macro ​ - ​ F 1 J=r-\mathrm{MAE}+\mathrm{Macro\text{-}F}_{1} , where r r is the Pearson correlation; the clean condition and the mean over the 20%, 40%, and 60% missing-rate conditions each receive weight 0.5, and the intensity cut-points used by the Macro-F1 term are re-tuned on validation predictions at each epoch. The LoRA expert and the fused configuration are selected by the mean of clean and 40% mixed-missingness macro-F1 on validation. Fusion weights are searched on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] in steps of 0.1, exponents on { 1 , 2 , 4 } \{1,2,4\} , and class biases on [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] in steps of 0.1 and then refined in steps of 0.025. These settings were frozen before the held-out evaluation reported here. The held-out split had already been inspected during development, so it does not provide a blind estimate. The candidate set and its validation results are listed in Appendix E .

blocks.en: “Clean” inputs contain only the natural zero-vector positions. For “mixed40”, each utterance is assigned a damaged-modality subset drawn from the seven non-empty combinations (T, A, V, TA, TV, AV, TAV), and each damaged modality loses ⌈ 0.4 ​ ℓ ⌉ \lceil 0.4\ell\rceil positions in one contiguous span (placement seed 20260923). Thus 40% is the per-modality ratio, not the fraction of utterances with all modalities missing. The 21-condition grid applies the seven subsets at 20%, 40%, and 60%. Feature masking is applied after context encoding, so text outside the masked span may still reflect masked words; we address this with a pre-encoding deletion check.
blocks.zh: “干净”输入只包含天然零载体位置。 就“混合40”而言,每句话都得到一个从7个非空组合(T、A、V、TA、TV、AV、TAV)中抽取的被损坏模式子集,每个被损坏模式在一个相接的跨度中损失了0.4 l\lceil 0.4\ell\rceil位置(放置种子20260923)。 因此,40%是按模式计算的比率,而不是所有模式缺失的言论的一小部分。 21个条件的网格以20%,40%和60%的比例应用了7个子集. 特性遮盖在上下文编码后被应用,因此被遮盖的跨度外的文本可能仍然会反映被遮盖的单词;我们用编码前的删除检查来解决这个问题.

blocks.en: We report Accuracy, Macro-F1, MAE, and Pearson r r . Classes come from the argmax of the fused probabilities, and intensity comes from the fused intensity. Because utterances from the same video are correlated, the main comparisons use 5,000 paired bootstrap resamples ( Efron, 1979 ) over source videos, keeping both views of each video together, together with a two-sided video-cluster permutation test. The deletion and retention intervals in Table 5 are computed differently: they use 500 paired bootstrap resamples over utterances, keeping each utterance’s curve intact, and do not cluster by source video.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports the change in Macro-F1 and MAE over the 21 fixed conditions on the held-out split. The fused model improves Macro-F1 in 19 conditions and reduces MAE in all 21. Both decreases in Macro-F1 occur when text is heavily masked: text alone at 60% (-0.30 points) and all three modalities at 60% (-1.44 points). When text is intact, the expert helps most, with gains of 2.87 to 3.66 points for A, V, and AV. Gains are smaller for TA and TV, and MAE reductions are largest for the audio and visual subsets. Position analysis on validation shows that text masking at the head, middle, and tail of the utterance increases MAE by 0.0214, 0.0165, and 0.0287; audio and visual masking change MAE by at most 0.0022. Groups in this analysis use different samples, so these differences are descriptive. Text spans of 13 or more positions produce the largest MAE increase (0.0343), but these groups also differ in missing ratio and sentence length, so the trend cannot be attributed to absolute length alone. When all text is absent, held-out Macro-F1 falls to 0.454; when all three modalities are absent, the output reduces to a learned prior and Macro-F1 is 0.148. Appendix C reports the core-network scans, and Appendix D gives the position, length, and replay analyses.

blocks.en: 6.5 Robustness to pre-encoding text-span deletion
blocks.zh: 6.5 编码前删除文本宽度

blocks.en: Encoded-feature masking can leave context from deleted words in the surviving positions. To test this, we deleted the characters covered by the masked spans of the validation mixed40 condition before re-encoding, re-encoded the remaining text with the frozen BERT and each LoRA expert, mapped the surviving subwords back to their original positions, and kept audio, vision, and masks unchanged. Because span boundaries follow subword offsets, a boundary can split a word, so this is not strictly whole-word deletion. Under this stricter protocol, the fused Macro-F1 under missingness falls from 0.6394 to 0.6065 (MAE rises from 0.5722 to 0.5930), and the RM-Net core reaches 0.5813 on the same condition. The fused model therefore still gains over the core, but masking of encoded features overstates performance when the words are truly unavailable. This check was run only on validation and was not used for selection. A separate grouped five-fold check on the training split gives a mean two-view Macro-F1 of 0.6170 with standard deviation 0.0073 for a single adapter, which measures stability of one configuration and is not a nested estimate for the five-seed model. Appendix D gives the details of both checks.
blocks.zh: 在幸存位置上被删除的文字可以留下上下文. 为了测试这一点,我们在重新编码前删除了验证混合40条件所覆盖的被遮盖的字符,用被冻结的BERT和每个LORA专家重新编码了剩余文字,将幸存的子词映射回了原来的位置,并保持了音频,视觉和口罩不变. 因为跨边界跟随子词相抵消,一个边界可以分出一个字,所以这严格来说不是整字删除. 在这种更严格的协议下,失能下被引信的Macro-F1从0.6394降至0.6065(MAE从0.5722升至0.5930),而RM-Net核心在同一条件下也达到了0.5813. 因此,被保险的模型仍然比核心有所增益,但在真正没有字的情况下,被编码的特征的遮盖会过度地描述性能. 此检查仅在验证时运行, 没有用于选择 。 单独分组的对训练分拆的五倍检查给出了0.6170的正双视Macro-F1,一个单一适配器的标准偏差为0.073,它测量一个配置的稳定性,并不是五种子模型的嵌入估计. 附 录 D提供了这两笔支票的细节。

blocks.en: 6.6 Dual-target explanations
blocks.zh: 6.6 双重目标解释

blocks.en: Table 5 and Figure 2 report fidelity on 728 validation utterances. Deleting top-ranked positions lowers predicted-class probability faster than random deletion: AUC is 0.137 versus 0.024, a paired difference of 0.113 (interval [ 0.108 , 0.117 ] [0.108,0.117] ). Intensity deletion agrees. Retention does not support sufficiency: top-ranked positions yield higher intensity retention AUC of | Δ ​ y | |\Delta y| than random positions (0.1796 versus 0.1659), indicating greater average deviation from the full-input intensity. For class probability, negative signed retention AUC ( − 0.0645 -0.0645 versus 0.0365 0.0365 for random orderings) means probability rises on average over the integrated curve. This does not guarantee probability at or above the full-input level for every utterance or retained fraction. We therefore report retention descriptively.
blocks.zh: 表5和图2报告了728份鉴定意见的忠实程度。 删除上等位置会比随机删除更快地降低预测等级概率:AUC为0.137对0.024,对相差0.113(间隔[0.108,0.117] [0.108,0.117]). 强度删除同意. 保留不支持充足性:排名最高的姿势产生较高的强度保留AUC为QQ y QQDelta y 相较于随机姿势(0.1796比0.1659),表明与全输入强度的平均偏差较大. 对于类概率,负签字保留AUC(-0.0645-0.0645相比于随机订购的0.0365-0.0365相比)是指在集成曲线上的平均概率上升. 这不能保证每个言论或保留分数的概率达到或超过全部投入水平。 因此,我们描述性地报告保留情况。

blocks.en: Attributions satisfy the Shapley efficiency identity to within 4.4 × 10 − 16 4.4\times 10^{-16} . In 12 recomputations of intervention outputs (three unlabeled utterances under four conditions each), the largest discrepancy was 2.4 × 10 − 7 2.4\times 10^{-7} for intensity and 2.7 × 10 − 8 2.7\times 10^{-8} for probability, with identical classes; stored single-precision text contexts were reused, while pooling, prediction, and fusion were recomputed. The first flip along the selected classification order is summarized as a censored count: an utterance that never flips is assigned K + 1 K+1 , where K K is its number of content positions. The median count is 11 deleted positions for the selected order and 18 for random permutations, where the five permutations are averaged within each utterance before the median is taken across utterances. Under the selected order, 272 of 728 utterances (37.4%) never flip. For the 357 validation utterances in which the text and vision contributions to the class probability have opposite signs, the error rate is 38.9%, compared with 32.4% for the rest. This pattern suggests a review priority, but it is not evidence that the conflict causes errors. Appendix G gives the definitions, numerical checks, word-deletion comparison, and sample-level cases.
blocks.zh: 捐款满足了Shapley的效率特性,在4.4×10−16 4.4\times 10×16}之内。 在12次干预产出的重算中(每次3个无标签的语句),最大的差异是强度2.4×10-7 2.4\times 10×7),概率为2.7×10-8 2.7\times 10×8),分类相同;存储的单精度文本上下文被再用,同时集合,预测和聚变被重算. 沿所选分类顺序的第一个翻转被概括为被审查的计数:一个从未翻转过的语句被指定为K+1 K+1,其中KK是其内容位数. 中位数为所选顺序被删除的11个位置和随机排列的18个位置,其中5个位置在中位数跨词取出之前在每句话中被平均取出. 根据所选顺序,728个语音中有272个(37.4%)从未翻转. 在357个验证语句中,文本和视觉对类概率的贡献有相反的征兆,错误率为38.9%,其余为32.4%。 这种模式表明优先审查,但不能证明冲突造成错误。 附 录 G给出定义,数字检查,字词删除比较,以及样本级案例.

blocks.en: 6.7 Error diagnostics
blocks.zh: 6.7 错误诊断

blocks.en: Figure 3 (a) shows that fusion lowers held-out MAE for neutral, weak, and moderate sentiment under clean and 40% mixed-missing inputs, but raises it for strong sentiment: 1.063 to 1.071 on clean inputs and 1.074 to 1.077 under mixed missingness. In the validation mixed-missingness confusion matrix (b), 107 of 223 Neutral predictions are correct; 37 are truly Negative and 79 Positive (precision 0.480, recall 0.582). Neutral is also the weakest class on clean inputs (Appendix D ). Panel (c) shows text dominates 563 of 728 intensity attributions and 681 of 728 class attributions; audio dominates 60 and 7, and vision 105 and 40. These fused-predictor attributions describe model dependence, not an absence of information in audio or vision.
blocks.zh: 图3(a)显示,聚变降低中性、弱和中性情绪的MAE在清洁和40%的混合缺失投入下,但提高为强烈情绪:1.063至1.071在清洁投入上;1.074至1.077在混合缺失下。 在验证的混合-缺失混淆矩阵(b)中,223个中立预测中有107个是正确的;37个是真正的负数,79个是正数(精度0.480,回想0.582)。 中立性也是清洁投入最弱的一类(附录 D. (c) 显示文本在728个强度归属中占563个,在728个类别归属中占681个;音频在60个和7个,以及视觉105和40个。 这些被引信的先导属性描述了模型依赖性,而不是在音频或视觉中缺乏信息.

blocks.en: 6.8 Unlabeled predictions
blocks.zh: 6.8 无标签的预测

blocks.en: On the 30 unlabeled utterances with zero-valued spans, the fused model predicts 6 Negative, 13 Neutral, and 11 Positive. The text-availability fraction ranges from 0.50 to 1.00, and 27 of the 30 utterances contain [UNK] tokens. On the 20-utterance explanation set, the predictions are 8 Negative, 5 Neutral, and 7 Positive. Text is the dominant class-level modality in all 20 cases, while intensity is dominated by text in 16 cases and by vision in 4. These sets have no labels, so we report distributions and explanations but no accuracy. Appendix H lists every prediction and its evidence.
blocks.zh: 在30个无标签的无标值跨度的言论上,被引信的模型预测有6个负数,13个中数,11个正数. 文本的可用分数从0.50到1.00不等,30个语音中有27个包含[UNK]符号. 在20口腔解释集上,预测为8负,5中和7正. 文本是所有20个案例的主导类级模式,而强度则由16个案例的文本和4个案例的视觉所主导. 这些设备没有标签,所以我们报告分布和解释,但没有准确性。 附 录 H列出了每一个预测及其证据.

blocks.en: 6.9 Auditable word-level alignment for raw clips
blocks.zh: 6.9 对生片段的可审计字级调整

blocks.en: A separate pipeline extracts word-level features for 100 raw clips from 37 videos in the supplied CMU-MOSEI-derived package, with their transcripts and labels. Each word receives BERT features averaged over WordPieces, 74 acoustic dimensions at a 10 ms hop, and 35 facial dimensions at 25 Hz. CTC forced alignment with wav2vec 2.0 posteriors supplies word boundaries ( Graves et al., 2006 ; Baevski et al., 2020 ) . The time-quality gate applies fixed thresholds to word and clip-mean alignment posteriors and greedy-decoding WER. Of 1,926 words, 1,316 (68.3%) pass, across 65 clips. Two independent extractions match in all 500 files. Word-level grouping retains less acoustic variance than 0.25 s windows (0.249 versus 0.312), but more than 0.5 s and 1 s windows (0.185 and 0.107); this is descriptive, not sentiment accuracy. Pipeline outputs do not train or evaluate the sentiment models. Appendix F shows a typical clip with all ten words passing (Figure 8 ) and quality across clips (Figure 9 ).
blocks.zh: 一个单独的管道从提供的CMU-MOSEI出品包中的37个视频中提取出100个原始片段的文字层次特征,并附有其笔录和标签. 每个单词平均接收到WordPieces之上的BERT特征,一个10ms hop的74个声学维度,以及25hz的35个面部维度. CTC强制与wav2vec 2.0后方对齐,提供词边界(Graves等,2006;Baevski等,2020.). 时间质量门对词和剪接-正则对接后和贪婪的解码WER应用了固定阈值. 1,926个单词中,有1,316个(68.3%)通过,跨越了65个片段. 在所有500个文件中,两个独立提取匹配. 单词级分组保留的声音差异小于0.25 s窗口(0.249对0.312),但超过0.5 s和1 s窗口(0.185和0.107);这是描述性的,不是情绪的准确性. 管道输出不培训或评价情绪模型。 附 录 F显示一个典型的片段,所有十个词都通过(图8),质量跨越片段(图9).

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Three findings emerge. First, retaining positions and marking missing spans permits position-level inspection; without a position-dropping control, we cannot attribute accuracy to this design. Second, text-expert fusion improves the held-out two-view average over the core, but Macro-F1 gains shrink under heavy text masking (60%) and reverse for T and TAV. Without a fixed-weight control, we cannot attribute gains to availability-dependent weighting alone. Third, explanation-ranked removal changes predicted-class probability much more than random removal.
blocks.zh: 得出了三个结论。 首先,保留职位和标记缺失的时间跨度允许进行职位级别检查;如果没有职位投放控制,我们不能将准确性归因于这种设计。 其次,文本专家聚变改善了被搁置的两相取而代之的核心平均值,但Macro-F1增益在重文本遮掩下收缩了(60%)并反之为T和TAV. 没有固定的重量控制,我们就不能将收益归结为依赖可用量的加权。 第三,按解释排序的去除变化预测的类概率远大于随机去除.

blocks.en: Deployment limits remain: gains vary across conditions, and encoded-feature masking overstates performance when words are unavailable. Validation selection and earlier held-out inspection mean the reported numbers are estimates, not a fresh test. Our controlled, auditable method and analysis make no state-of-the-art claim.
blocks.zh: 部署限额仍然存在:增益因条件不同而异,在无法使用文字时,编码的地貌遮盖会过度描述性能. 审定选择和较早的搁置检查意味着所报告的数字是估计数,而不是新的测试。 我们的控制、可审计的方法和分析没有提出最先进的索赔。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: RM-Net handles contiguous missingness, fusing with a LoRA-adapted BERT expert weighted only by visible text. Frozen on validation, fusion improves held-out two-view macro-F1 by 0.024 over the auxiliary-head baseline, most when text is intact. Dual-target Shapley and occlusion identify positions affecting deployed predictions. Future work includes fresh blind evaluation, human assessment of explanations, probability calibration, and integration of word-level alignment with prediction.
blocks.zh: RM-Net处理相接相接的缺失,用一个经LORA调整的BERT专家来引信,只用可见文本加权. 在验证时被冻结,聚变在辅助头基线上以0.024来改进所持有的二视宏-F1,大多数情况下文本完好无损. 双目标轴和隐蔽物确定影响部署预测的位置。 今后的工作包括新的盲目评价、人类对解释的评估、概率校准、以及将字级与预测相结合。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our results rest on several assumptions that limit their scope. The held-out split was inspected during development, and validation was used for every selection; the reported held-out numbers are therefore not a blind test, and the fused model’s advantage over the baseline is an estimate with uncertainty from a single 727-utterance split. Missingness is simulated by masking precomputed features after context encoding. Because text positions may still encode the masked words, the masked-encoding numbers overstate performance when words are truly unavailable; our pre-encoding deletion check covers only the validation split and only the mixed40 condition. Performance gains are uneven: the fused model loses Macro-F1 when text is heavily masked, and masking all three modalities at 60% reduces Macro-F1 by 1.44 points relative to the baseline. The text-availability weighting is a fixed rule designed on validation, and the class biases improve validation but not the held-out ranking. The probabilities are not calibrated, so they should not be read as confidence. Ensemble spread is not evaluated for coverage.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果取决于限制其范围的若干假设。 在开发过程中检查了被搁置的拆分,每次选择都采用了验证方法;因此,所报告的被搁置的数字并不是盲目测试,而引信模型相对于基线的优势是,从单一的727-拆分中得出一个不确定的估计。 缺失由上下文编码后被遮住的预计算特征所模拟. 因为文字位置可能仍然会将被遮蔽的字进行编码,所以被遮蔽的编码数字在真正没有文字时会过度地描述性能;我们的预编码删除检查只涵盖验证分拆,只涵盖混合40条件. 性能增益不均:被引信的模型在文本被严重遮掩时会丢失Macro-F1,而将所有三种模式以60%遮掩后,Macro-F1相对于基线减少1.44分. 文本可用性权重是用于验证的固定规则,阶级偏差改进了验证,而不是被搁置的排名. 概率不校正,所以不应被解读为自信. 组合传播不评估覆盖范围。

blocks.en: The explanations are faithful to the deployed predictor under the stated interventions, but they describe model dependence rather than human emotional causation. The intervals in Table 5 resample utterances rather than source videos; because utterances from the same video are correlated, they may understate uncertainty and should be read as descriptive. Retention curves are not clear evidence of sufficiency. We have not yet completed cross-seed and randomization checks for the fused model’s occlusion rankings, and the explanation evidence has not been annotated by humans. The word-level alignment pipeline lacks human word-boundary ground truth, its time gate is a heuristic, and its outputs do not feed the sentiment models. Our experiments use one English dataset and pre-extracted features with a fixed text encoder, so they do not establish performance on other languages, domains, or sensors. We did not run physical-device or real-time evaluations, and total compute was not logged in full.
blocks.zh: 这些解释对所述干预措施下部署的预测者是忠实的,但它们描述了模型依赖性而不是人类情感的因果关系。 表5中的间隔时间是重复的,而不是源视频;由于同一视频中的表述相互关联,它们可能低估了不确定性,应当被理解为描述性. 保留曲线并不是充分性的明确证据。 我们还没有完成对被引信模型的隔离级的交叉种子和随机检查,解释证据也没有被人类注解. 单词级对接管道缺乏人字边界地面真理,其时间门是heuristic,其输出不为情绪模型提供素材. 我们的实验使用一个英文数据集和有固定文本编码器的预取功能,因此它们不会在其他语言,域或传感器上建立性能. 我们没有进行物理检测或实时评估,计算总数也没有完全记录。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: CMU-MOSEI consists of online videos of speakers. The predictive experiments used only the supplied precomputed numerical features, which are numerical descriptors rather than images, and did not attempt to identify any speaker. The separate alignment experiment decoded 100 raw clips from 37 videos in the supplied CMU-MOSEI-derived package, together with their transcripts; face detection there served only to compute numerical per-frame descriptors. The official CMU-MOSEI SDK distributes processed features rather than raw videos, so we did not verify the supplied clips against the original YouTube sources. The separate code supplement excludes raw videos and removes transcript text from its CSV evidence; the EmoMosaic data repository includes source media and transcripts. We used the dataset for research purposes only. Sentiment prediction from speech, text, and facial behavior can be misused for surveillance, manipulation, or unfair screening, and a model that performs well on average can still fail on particular speakers, languages, or expression styles. The explanations in this paper expose input dependence but do not establish that a person feels any emotion, and they should not be used as evidence about individuals. We recommend that any deployment be restricted to consenting users, be evaluated for subgroup performance, and keep a human in the loop for consequential decisions.
blocks.zh: CMU-MOSEI由在线演讲者视频组成. 预测实验只使用了所提供的预先计算的数字特征,这些特征是数字描述符而不是图像,没有试图识别任何发言者。 单独的对齐实验从提供的CMU-MOSEI出品包的37个视频中解码出100个生片段及其笔录;在那里的面部检测只用于计算每帧标注的数字. 官方CMU-MOSEI SDK发布被处理的特质而不是原始视频,因此我们没有对照原始YouTube来源核实所提供的剪辑. 单独的代码补充将原始视频排除在外,并从其CSV证据中去掉记录文本;EmoMosaic数据存储库包括源媒体和记录文本. 我们使用数据集只是为了研究目的。 来自语音,文字,和面部行为的感官预测可能会被滥用于监视,操纵,或不公平的筛选,平均表现良好的模型仍然会在特定的演讲者,语言,或表达风格上失败. 本文中的解释暴露出输入依赖性,但并不确定一个人感到任何情感,不应被作为个人的证据. 我们建议,任何部署应限于同意的用户,评价分组业绩,并让人随时参与相应决定。

blocks.en: Offensive content. The released dataset includes source media and transcripts and may therefore contain offensive language or other objectionable material. No systematic offensive-content audit of the source data was performed.
blocks.zh: 攻击性内容。 公布的数据集包括源媒体和誊本,因此可能包含攻击性语言或其他可反对的材料. 未对来源数据进行系统的攻击性内容审计。

blocks.en: Environmental considerations. RM-Net checkpoints were trained on four consumer-grade RTX 3090 GPUs with BF16 mixed precision, and the released core checkpoint is about 3 MB, while large pretrained weights are excluded from the release. Total GPU hours and energy consumption were not logged over the course of development, so we cannot report a precise compute footprint; this is stated in the experimental protocol (paragraph “Compute”) and in the Limitations section.

blocks.en: The text expert freezes the BERT-base encoder and adds rank-8 LoRA updates with α = 16 \alpha=16 to the query and value projections of each of the 12 layers. The trainable adapters contain about 0.29M parameters, excluding the task heads. Mean pooling runs over the visible positions that are not [UNK] , including visible special tokens; if no position is usable, the pooled vector is zero. The classification and intensity heads share one 128-unit hidden layer, each followed by its own linear output. The expert loss is class-weighted cross-entropy over the clean and damaged views plus 0.3 0.3 times an L1 intensity loss. The fusion equations and the frozen constants are those given in Section 4 ; the fusion weights, exponents, and class biases were chosen on the validation split with the grids listed in Table 6 .

blocks.zh: 表7汇总了每笔款项的对齐释放情况。 长度为有效位置的中位数. 零帧比是有效位置的分数,其原始音频或视觉向量都为零;它们结合了结构零,自然沉默或缺失的面相,以及释放中已经存在的任何缺失的跨度,无法相分离.

blocks.en: Table 7: Aligned release (50 positions per modality). Neutral corresponds exactly to y = 0 y=0 and is 22.3% of the training split.
blocks.zh: 表7:对齐释放(每种方式50个位置)。 中性完全对应y=0y=0,为训练分数的22.3%.

blocks.en: The validation split contains 239 source videos. Two provisions of the release affect the analysis. First, the 50 positions are token positions of the text sequence, so a position is not a word or a fixed time interval. Second, the text positions of padding are not zero in the precomputed text features, so the valid length is read from the attention mask and not from the text vectors.
blocks.zh: 验证分拆包含239个源视频. 释放的两项规定影响了分析。 首先,50个位置是文本序列的象征位置,因此一个位置不是一字或固定的时间间隔. 第二,在预算的文本特性中,被粘贴的文本位置不是零,因此有效长度是从注意口罩读取,而不是从文本向量读取.

blocks.en: B.2 Re-extraction of text features
blocks.zh: B.2 重新提取文本特征

blocks.en: Text features were re-extracted with the frozen uncased BERT-base encoder at a fixed revision, for all splits and for the unlabeled sets, so that the text branch and the text expert use identical inputs. On observed positions, the re-extracted features differ from the supplied text features by a mean absolute value on the order of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , which is consistent with half-precision storage.
blocks.zh: 文本特性在固定的修订版中被重新取出被冻结的未保存的BERT-碱编码器,用于所有分集和未贴标签的集,从而使文本分支和文本专家使用相同的输入. 在所观测到的位置上,再取出的特点与所提供的文本特征不同,取取3×10−4 3\times 10×4}的正绝对值,这与半精度存储一致.

blocks.en: B.3 Availability in the unlabeled sets
blocks.zh: B.3 未贴标签的套件的可用性

blocks.en: In unlabeled set A (30 utterances), 27 utterances contain at least one [UNK] token, for 131 positions in total. These positions have non-zero BERT vectors but are excluded from the numerator of the visible-text fraction, following the rule in Section 4 . The special tokens [CLS] and [SEP] are excluded from both numerator and denominator. Consequently the visible-text fraction ranges from 0.50 to 1.00 across set A. Audio and visual zero spans in set A may be structural, natural, or artificially imposed; the release does not label their origin, so they are treated as observed by the model only when the raw vector is non-zero.
blocks.zh: 在未加标签的成套A(30个语句)中,27个语句至少包含一个[联合国]符号,共131个位置。 这些位置有非零BERT向量,但按照第四节的规则,从可见文本分数的分数中排除. 特殊符牌[CLS]和[SEP]均从数字和分母中排除. 因此,可见文本分数从0.50到1.00不等。 A组中的音频和视觉零跨可能是结构、自然或人为强加的;释放时不标出其来源,因此只有当原始矢量为非零时,才按模型观测到的处理。

blocks.en: Appendix C Robustness Scans of the Core Network
blocks.zh: 附录C 扫描核心网络

blocks.en: This section reports controlled scans of the RM-Net core, the network before the text expert is fused. The scans were run on the validation split with the historical intensity-threshold rule for classification; they are not the fused predictor’s classification curves. Their intensity errors (MAE) do not depend on that rule, and they are reported here to show how the core responds to each kind of missingness. The scans use the same contiguous-span masking as the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 本节报告对RM-Net核心的控制扫描,网络在文本专家被引信之前. 扫描是在与历史强度-阈值规则进行分类的验证分割上进行的;它们不是引信预测器的分类曲线。 它们的强度误差(MAE)并不取决于该规则,这里报告它们是为了显示核心如何应对每一种缺失. 扫描采用与主要实验相同的相接-平面遮罩.

blocks.en: C.1 Missing fraction and modality subset
blocks.zh: 页:1 缺少分数和模式子集

blocks.en: Figure 4 varies the missing fraction from 0 to 1 in steps of 0.1 for each of the seven damaged-modality subsets, with five training seeds and five span placements. Missing text has the largest effect. At 80% text missing, MAE is about 0.648, and when text is fully missing it rises to about 0.801. Fully missing audio or visual alone gives MAE of about 0.611 and 0.604. When all three modalities are missing, the output falls back to the learned prior. These results describe the locally missing regime and do not extend to total information loss.
blocks.zh: 图4对7个被破坏模式子集中的每个小分集的缺失分数从0到1相差0.1分,有5个训练种子和5个跨度布置. 缺少文本的效果最大. 以80%的文本缺失率,MAE大约为0.648,当文本完全缺失时会上升到约0.801. 完全缺失的音频或视觉单给MAE大约0.611和0.604. 当所有三种模式都缺失时,输出会回落到之前学到的. 这些结果说明了当地缺失的制度,并不延伸至全部信息损失。

blocks.en: Figure 4: RM-Net core under increasing missingness on the validation split. Each panel is one damaged-modality subset; the blue curve is Macro-F1 (historical thresholds) and the orange curve is MAE. Shading is the standard deviation across five training seeds, after averaging over placements within each seed.
blocks.zh: 图4:RM-Net核心在验证拆分时越来越缺失。 每个面板为被破坏-模式子集;蓝色曲线为Macro-F1(历史阈值),橙色曲线为MAE. 遮蔽是5个训练种子的标准偏差,在每种种子平均放置后。

blocks.en: C.2 Span position
blocks.zh: C.2 平坦位置

blocks.en: Figure 5 compares spans placed at the start, middle, and end of the admissible range, at missing fractions 0.3 and 0.5. Averaged over the two fractions, text MAE is 0.616 for the start, 0.593 for the middle, and 0.607 for the end, so the start is the most sensitive position for text. Because the start also includes the [CLS] token and the first content words, this experiment cannot separate the two effects. Audio and visual differences across positions are small.
blocks.zh: 图5比较了可受理范围的起始、中间和末段,缺失分数为0.3和0.5。 平均在两个分数上,文字MAE为起始0.616分,中间为0.593分,结尾为0.607分,因此开头是文字最敏感的位置. 由于起步也包含[CLS]符和第一个内容单词,这个实验无法将两种效果分开. 不同位置的视听差异很小。

blocks.en: Figure 5: MAE of the RM-Net core by damaged-modality subset (rows) and span position (columns) at missing fractions 0.3 (left) and 0.5 (right). Colour scales differ between the two panels.
blocks.zh: 图5:RM-Net核心的MAE按损坏模式子集(行)和相距位置(列)在缺失分数0.3(左)和0.5(右). 两个面板的颜色尺度不同。

blocks.en: C.3 Span length and reconstruction
blocks.zh: C.3 宽度和重建

blocks.en: Figure 6 removes 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, or 12 valid positions. Visual reconstruction R 2 R^{2} on the removed positions falls from 0.408 to 0.277, audio from 0.084 to 0.045, and text stays between − 0.015 -0.015 and − 0.007 -0.007 . Reconstruction is therefore informative for vision and weak for audio, and text reconstruction does not beat a constant predictor. The right panel varies the start of a three-position window; MAE varies by about 0.015 across the admissible range, so the effect of placement is modest for short spans.
blocks.zh: 图6取消了1,2,3,5,8或12个有效位置. 被拆除位置上的视觉重建R 2 R^{2}从0.408降至0.277,音频从0.084降至0.045,文本停留在0.015-0.015-0.007之间. 因此,重建对于视觉是信息化的,对于音频是弱的,文本重建不会比一个恒定的预测器强. 右面板会改变三位置窗口的起步;MAE在可接受范围上会相差约0.015,因此放置的效果在短时期内是微小的.

blocks.en: Two further observations are recorded here. First, under 40% text missingness, one contiguous span gives an MAE of 0.603 and four spans give 0.599; this small difference was not tested for significance. Second, the mean text gate weight of the core rises only from 0.531 to 0.548 as the text missing fraction increases from 10% to 90%, so the gate does not decrease monotonically with missingness. The gate is an internal weight, not a calibrated reliability estimate.

blocks.en: Figure 6: RM-Net core under span length and placement. Left: MAE as the number of removed positions grows, by modality subset. Middle: reconstruction R 2 R^{2} on the removed positions for single-modality removal. Right: MAE of a three-position window as its relative start varies.
blocks.zh: 图6:跨度和位置的RM-Net核心。 左: MEE 随被移除位置数量的增加而增加,按模式子集. 中间:重建R 2 R^{2}被移除位置 单模式去除. 对: 一个三相窗口的MAE因其相对起始而不同.

blocks.en: Appendix D Fused-Model Missingness and Validation Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录D 引信模型缺失和鉴定诊断

blocks.en: This section expands the diagnostics of the fused model summarized in Section 6 . The validation split was used for model development, so every number here describes the frozen model on data it was tuned on, and none is a blind test.
blocks.zh: 本节扩展了第6节概述的引信模型的诊断。 验证分解被用于模型开发,因此这里的每一个数字都描述了它所调取的数据上被冻结的模型,没有一个是盲目测试.

blocks.en: D.1 Per-utterance changes under mixed missingness
blocks.zh: D.1 联合国 混合缺失情况下的百分率变化

blocks.en: On the 728 validation utterances, 447 are classified correctly under both clean and 40% mixed-missing inputs, and 233 are wrong under both. Missingness flips 22 correct predictions to wrong and 26 wrong predictions to correct. The average Macro-F1 change therefore reflects cancelling per-utterance changes, not a uniform effect. Table 8 shows one case per true class: for each class, the flipped utterance with the largest increase in absolute intensity error. The cases illustrate failure modes and were not used for any selection. Spans are position indices, starting at 0 and half-open; “ ∅ \varnothing ” means that the modality received no additional mask.
blocks.zh: 在728个验证语句上,447个被正确分类为"干净"和"40%混合缺失"两种输入,233个两者都是错误的. 缺失将22个正确的预测翻为错误,将26个错误的预测翻为正确. 因此,Macro-F1的平均变化反映的是取消过量变化,而不是一种统一的效果。 表8显示每个真实类的1个案例:每个类的翻转语,绝对强度误差最大. 这些案例说明了失败模式,没有用于任何选择。 Spans是位置指数,从0到半开;“\\ varulty ” 表示该模式没有收到额外的口罩。

blocks.en: Table 8: Representative flips under mixed missingness on the validation split. Audio and visual spans are [ 4 , 16 ) [4,16) and [ 15 , 27 ) [15,27) for V1, [ 6 , 15 ) [6,15) and [ 3 , 12 ) [3,12) for V2, and [ 30 , 50 ) [30,50) and ∅ \varnothing for V3.

V1 describes difficulty in obtaining educational resources; its text span covers the phrase “really difficult for me”, and the negative prediction turns positive when that span and different parts of the audio and vision are removed. V2 is a factual statement whose neutral reading is lost when a position in the text tail is masked. V3 contains a positive evaluation; masking that span together with the end of the audio turns a positive prediction negative. These examples show that locally masked cues can change the decision, but multiple modalities change together, so they do not identify a single cause.
blocks.zh: V1描述了在获取教育资源方面的困难;其文本涵盖“对我来说确实困难”这一短语,当这一段以及音频和视觉的不同部分被删除时,负面预测变为正数。 V2是一种事实性陈述,当文字尾部的一个位置被蒙上后会失去中性读取. V3包含一个正评价;与音频结尾相通的遮掩会变成正预测负. 这些例子表明,被地方遮住的提示可以改变决定,但多种模式一起改变,因此它们无法识别出一个单一的原因.

blocks.en: D.2 Position and length groups
blocks.zh: D.2 职位和长度组

blocks.en: Table 9 gives the paired increase in MAE caused by masking (masked minus clean) for the validation split. The length groups pool the 20%, 40%, and 60% conditions, giving 2,184 records per modality (728 utterances at three rates), so records from the same utterance are not independent. Text spans starting at the head, middle, and tail of the admissible range increase MAE by 0.0214, 0.0165, and 0.0287. Audio and visual changes are at most 0.0022. For text, longer spans have larger increases, but the groups also differ in missing ratio and sentence length, so the trend does not isolate absolute length.
blocks.zh: 表9给出了为验证拆分而用口罩(口罩减干净)造成的MAE成对增加。 长度组集合了20%、40%和60%的条件,每个模式提供了2 184个记录(728个3个比例的语句),因此,同一语句的记录是不独立的。 文字从可允许范围的头,中和尾部起,增加MAE 0.0214,0.0165和0.0287. 视听变化最多为0.0022. 对于文字来说,较长的长度有较大的增加,但各组在缺失比例和句子长度上也有不同,因此趋势并不孤立绝对长度.

blocks.en: Table 9: Paired increase in validation MAE caused by text masking (masked minus clean). Position uses the 40% condition; length pools the 20%, 40%, and 60% conditions.
blocks.zh: 表9: 文字遮盖导致的认证MAE增加(面罩减干净)。 职位使用40%的条件;长度集合20%、40%和60%的条件。

blocks.en: D.3 Intensity groups and per-class behaviour
blocks.zh: D.3 强度群体和按阶级划分的行为

blocks.en: Table 10 reports validation MAE by true-intensity group for the fused model. Under mixed missingness, MAE rises for the moderate group (0.568 to 0.583), while the strong group remains the largest error source in both conditions. The neutral group is defined by | y | = 0 |y|=0 .
blocks.zh: 表10按引信模型的真实强度组报告MAE验证情况。 在混合缺失的情况下,MAE为中度组(0.568至0.583)而上升,而强出组在这两种情况下仍然是最大的出错源. 中性组由 QQ y = 0 |Y = 0.

blocks.en: Table 10: Validation MAE of the fused model by true-intensity group.
blocks.zh: 表10 按真实强度组分列的引信模型的验证MAE。

blocks.en: Table 11 gives per-class precision, recall, and F1 for the clean validation confusion matrix. The Neutral class is the weakest in all three measures. Under 40% mixed missingness, its precision is 0.480 and its recall 0.582 (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 表11为清洁验证混淆矩阵提供了每类精确度、召回率和F1。 中立阶级在所有三种度量中都是最弱的. 在40%的混合缺失度以下,其精度为0.480并被召回0.582(图3 ).

blocks.en: Table 11: Per-class metrics of the fused model on the clean validation split.
blocks.zh: 表11:在清洁验证分拆上,引信模型的每类计量标准。

blocks.en: D.4 Replay of the unlabeled-set zero spans
blocks.zh: D.4 未贴标签的零相间重放

blocks.en: The zero spans in unlabeled set A were replayed on the held-out split. Each of the 30 patterns was mapped to each of the 727 held-out utterances by normalizing its span positions to the utterance length. Figure 7 shows the Macro-F1 gain of the fused model over the RM-Net core for each pattern. Panel (a) replays only the zero spans; panel (b) also treats the [UNK] tokens of the set as extra text masking. The fused model improves Macro-F1 in all 30 patterns of panel (a), with a mean gain of 3.07 points. In panel (b) the mean gain falls to 1.36 points, and patterns 17, 20, and 21 are negative. The MAE reduction is positive for every pattern in both panels. The replay gives a condition-level view of the same effect, but its 30 patterns are not independent samples.
blocks.zh: 未贴标签的集 A 中的零跨度被重放在被搁置的拆分上 。 30个图案中的每个图案都标出727个被搁置的口号,使其间距位置正常化到口号长度。 图7显示每个模式的引信模型相对于RM-Net核心的宏-F1收益。 (a) 面板只重放零相间;面板 (b) 还将设定的 [UNK] 符号视为额外的文字遮盖. 被引信的模型改进了所有30个面板(a)模式中的Macro-F1,平均收益为3.07分. 在(b)面板中,平均收益降至1.36分,图案17、20和21为负数。 两个板块的每一种模式都呈正减值。 重播给出了同样效果的条件级视图,但其30个模式并不是独立的样本.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Held-out replay of the unlabeled-set A zero spans. Bars show the Macro-F1 gain of the fused model over the RM-Net core for each pattern (sample number 01–30). Panel (b) also masks the [UNK] positions of the set. The dashed line is the mean gain.
blocks.zh: 图7:无标签套装A零跨度被搁置回放. Bars显示每个模式(样本编号为01-30)的被引信模型在RM-Net核心之上的宏-F1收益. (b) 小组还掩盖了该套装置的[联合国]位置。 虚线是取而代之的

blocks.en: D.5 Pre-encoding text-span deletion and fold-level stability
blocks.zh: D.5 编码前文本宽度删除和折叠级稳定性

blocks.en: The pre-encoding deletion check removes the characters covered by the masked text spans in the validation mixed40 condition before re-encoding, re-encodes the remaining text with the frozen BERT and each LoRA expert, maps the surviving subwords back to the original positions, and keeps audio, vision, and masks unchanged. Under this protocol, the fused Macro-F1 falls from 0.6394 to 0.6065 and MAE rises from 0.5722 to 0.5930; the RM-Net core reaches Macro-F1 0.5813 on the same condition. Because span boundaries follow subword offsets, a boundary can split a word, so this check is not strictly whole-word deletion. The check was not used for selection.
blocks.zh: 预编码删除检查在重新编码前去掉验证混合40条件中被遮盖文本所覆盖的字符,将剩余文本与被冻结的BERT和每个LORA专家重新编码,将幸存的子词映射回原位置,并保持音频,视觉,口罩不变. 根据这一协议,被引信的Macro-F1从0.6394降至0.6065,而MAE从0.5722升至0.5930;RM-Net核心在同一条件下达到Macro-F10.5813. 因为横跨边界会跟随子字的相抵,一个边界可以分出一个字,所以这个检查严格来说不是全字删除. 检查没有用于选择 。

blocks.en: A grouped five-fold check was run inside the training split, with folds defined by source video. Each fold starts from the public BERT weights and trains a single LoRA adapter. The two-view Macro-F1 averages 0.6170 0.6170 across folds with standard deviation 0.0073 0.0073 . This measures the stability of one configuration and is not a nested estimate for the five-seed fused model.
blocks.zh: 在培训分拆内进行了组合的五倍检查,由源视频定义折叠. 每个折叠从公共BERT重量开始,并训练出单个LORA适配器. 二视宏-F1平均为0.6170 0.6170 横叠相通,标准偏差为0.0073 0.0073 . 这衡量一种配置的稳定性,不是五种子引信模型的嵌入估计.

blocks.en: Appendix E Model Selection and Frozen-Representation Comparisons
blocks.zh: 附录E 模型选择和冷冻-代表比较

blocks.en: The fused predictor was chosen from a set of candidates on the validation split. This section documents the candidate set, the replacement rule, and the alternatives that were not adopted, so that the selection can be audited.
blocks.zh: 引信预测器是从一组候选人中选取的,以进行验证。 本节收录了未采纳的候选人集,替换规则和替代方案,以便审核选择.

blocks.en: E.1 Candidate workflow after the frozen model
blocks.zh: E.1 冻结模式后的候选人工作流程

blocks.en: After the final model was frozen, nine workflow candidates were compared: the frozen model and eight additional ones. The additional candidates are two class-bias shrinkage variants (bias multiplied by 0.5 or 0), three quality-adaptive fusion variants, and three quality-adaptive fusion variants with a restricted review step. The review step runs only when text is present and the RM and LoRA classes disagree or the top two fused probabilities differ by less than 0.20; it adds at most two extra calls to the RM core with audio-visual or text-only inputs. The adaptive variants use 27 diagnostic features, and the review variant uses 49. Regularization strengths were 0.01, 0.1, and 1 for the learned variants. Each learned variant was fitted on out-of-fold predictions from five video-grouped folds of the training split.
blocks.zh: 最终模型被冻结后,比较了9个工作流程候选人:被冻结模型和另外8个. 附加的候选物有:两个类-比亚斯收缩变体(比亚斯乘以0.5或0),三个质地适应聚变体,和三个质地适应聚变体,限制审查步骤. 审查步骤只在文本存在且RM和LORA类存在异议或前两个被熔接的概率相差小于0.20时才运行;它最多增加了两个附加调用RM核心的音频-视频或仅文本输入. 适应变体使用27个诊断特征,审查变体使用49个. 正规化的优点是0.01、0.1和1。 每个学习到的变体都根据五个视频组合的组合培训组合的外延预测进行了安装。

blocks.en: A candidate could replace the frozen model only if all three conditions held on the validation split: the two-view mean Macro-F1 rose by at least 0.003; neither view’s Macro-F1 decreased; and the MAE of each view increased by at most 0.01. blocks.en: Table 13 reports every frozen-representation and fusion candidate that was evaluated, with the validation and held-out results. Two patterns are informative. First, the final configuration has the highest validation average of all candidates, with a margin of 0.0003 over the best frozen-representation fusion (RM-Net + BERT probe fusion + bias). Second, several candidates lead on individual held-out conditions, including the LoRA expert alone on the mixed split and the unbiased fusion on clean inputs. These differences do not form a consistent ranking, which is why the final choice is justified by the validation rule and not by the held-out numbers.

blocks.en: Encoded masking still lets surviving positions carry information about the deleted word, and real deletion also moves positions and changes the visible-text denominator. The comparison therefore combines context, sequence shifts, and reliability changes. Table 20 shows that the two interventions agree moderately for intensity and weakly for the class probability. Results from encoded masking should not be presented as the effect of words being truly unavailable.

blocks.en: G.6 Representative misclassifications
blocks.zh: G.6 代表错误分类

blocks.en: Table 21 gives three misclassified validation utterances, chosen to illustrate different failure modes. The choice does not affect any reported statistic, and their evidence is described below.

blocks.en: Table 21: Three misclassified validation utterances, chosen for illustration. The probability margin is the gap between the top two fused probabilities.
blocks.zh: 表 21: 国家 三个错分类的验证语句,选取来作说明. 概率比值是前两个引信概率相差.

blocks.en: E1’s text says the product is more convenient than boots that take forever to put on; the negative wording refers to the compared boots, and the model predicts a strongly negative intensity. The three top-ranked positions that support the predicted negative class come from “aren’t” and two occurrences of “just”, each with a small probability decrease. This points to the comparison structure as a candidate for further checking, not as an established cause. E2 is a factual statement that is positive in the label but neutral in the classification, while the regression output is weakly positive. The error lies on the boundary between weak positive and neutral. E3 is labelled neutral but describes convenience in a generally positive way. The top-ranked word, “guarantee”, has a negative probability effect, meaning that masking it slightly raises the predicted-class probability. Single-position rankings must therefore be read with their sign and in context.
blocks.zh: E1的文字说,产品比需要永远穿上的靴子更方便;负面措辞指被比较的靴子,模型预测出强烈的负强度. 支持预测负数等级的三个排名最高的位置来自“aren't”和“just”两起事件,每起概率都略有下降。 这说明比较结构是进一步核查的候选条件,而不是既定原因。 E2是一种在标签中为正但分类中为中性的事实陈述,而回归输出则微弱为正. 错误位于弱正中分界线上. E3被标记为中性,但以一般正面的方式描述方便. 排名最高的单词"guarante"具有负概率效应,即掩盖它会略微提高预测的-类概率. 因此,单位排名必须随其标志和背景阅读。

blocks.en: G.7 Set B, sample 19
blocks.zh: G.7 成套B,样本 19

blocks.en: Sample 19 of unlabeled set B is the reference case for the dual-target explanation. Its predicted polarity is Negative with fused intensity 0.034 and probability margin 0.270. The main modality for the classification is text, while the main modality for the intensity is vision. The Shapley values for the classification target are 0.25394 0.25394 (text), − 0.05226 -0.05226 (audio), and − 0.02965 -0.02965 (vision), so text raises the Negative probability and audio and vision offset it. For the intensity target, the values are − 0.25695 -0.25695 (text), 0.01894 0.01894 (audio), and 0.26464 0.26464 (vision), so the text and vision effects cancel. These values are relative to the empty-set baseline, so the main modality names alone do not determine the direction of a prediction.

blocks.en: G.8 Scope of the explanations
blocks.zh: G.8 解释的范围

blocks.en: The explanations are exact for the Shapley decomposition and for the stated interventions. They are not validated by cross-seed stability or randomized-parameter tests for the fused model, which remain to be done. They do not identify which word a human annotator would call evidence, and the time anchors come from the alignment pipeline, whose limits are documented in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 有关Shapley分解和所述干预的解释是准确的。 它们没有通过被引信模型的交叉种子稳定性或随机参数测试加以验证,这些测试仍有待完成。 它们没有说明人类注释者会调用哪个词,而且锚定时间来自对齐管道,其限度载于附录F。
